Section is the 'Guide to Contraindications and Precautions to Commonly Used Vaccines' appendix (page 16) of the 2025 child/adolescent schedule. It contains no recommendation to vaccinate or screen, so no rules were emitted.

Not represented: COVID-19 mRNA (Pfizer-BioNTech, Moderna) and protein subunit (Novavax) vaccines. Contraindication: severe allergic reaction after a previous dose or to a vaccine component. Precautions: non-severe allergy to a component or a non-severe immediate (<4 hours) reaction after a prior dose; myocarditis or pericarditis within 3 weeks after any COVID-19 dose; MIS-C or MIS-A; moderate or severe acute illness.

Not represented: inactivated influenza vaccines (IIV3, ccIIV3, RIV3). Contraindications: severe allergic reaction to a prior influenza vaccine or to a component (egg excluded for IIV3). Precautions: GBS within 6 weeks of a prior influenza dose; cross-product allergy history requiring administration in a supervised medical setting, with optional allergist consult; moderate or severe acute illness.

Not represented: LAIV3 (Flumist) contraindications. These are: prior severe allergic reaction; age 2–4 years with a history of asthma or wheezing; asplenia; immunocompromise; close contacts or caregivers of severely immunosuppressed persons; pregnancy; cochlear implant; CSF leak; aspirin or salicylate therapy in children and adolescents; recent antivirals (oseltamivir or zanamivir within 48 hours, peramivir within 5 days, baloxavir within 17 days).

Not represented: LAIV3 precautions. These are: GBS within 6 weeks; asthma at age 5 or older; underlying chronic pulmonary, cardiovascular (except isolated hypertension), renal, hepatic, neurologic, hematologic or metabolic conditions including diabetes; moderate or severe acute illness.

Several of these contraindications could become exclusions for influenza or COVID-19 vaccine rules, but this section states no such rule to attach them to. Most of them (allergy history, timing of adverse events, antiviral timing, close-contact status, acute illness) would also be uncomputable from structured EHR data.

Footnotes not represented: definitions of contraindication (vaccine should NOT be administered) and precaution (generally defer unless benefit outweighs risk, which is clinician judgment). Also not represented: references to package inserts, EUA fact sheets and PEG content, and product-specific prescribing information.
